claims.text: Across retained 3.5.0–3.7.5 releases, vSomeIP shows continuing work on routing/service discovery, endpoint architecture, concurrency/race robustness, platform portability and test infrastructure.
claims.context: Synthesis of project-authored release notes; not a claim of independent conformance or deployment maturity.

claims.text: The 3.7.0 notes include a client/server endpoint architecture rework and fully atomic offer/stop-service operations.
The 3.7.5 notes include support for multiple major-version offerings and broad routing-command/IPC refactoring.

limitations.text: Release notes establish project changes, not independent SOME/IP conformance, production deployment scale, safety qualification or comparative performance.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of vSomeIP-Lib 3.5.0; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes add lazy policy loading, event debouncing/selective events, SOME/IP-TP remote-address rework, security-configuration separation for applications in one process, and reliability fixes.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of vSomeIP-Lib 3.6.0; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes drop vsomeip2 compatibility and include endpoint/routing/service-subscription synchronization, suspend/resume/network-change and test-harness work.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of vSomeIP-Lib 3.7.0; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes include endpoint client/server restructuring, atomic offer/stop-service operations, connection control, service-discovery reliability fixes and substantial robustness/test work.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of vSomeIP-Lib 3.7.2; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes introduce hybrid mode and further separate/decouple endpoint/routing structures while addressing data races and service-discovery/routing synchronization.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of vSomeIP-Lib 3.7.3; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes upgrade the project to C++20 and continue endpoint, service-discovery and routing synchronization/refactoring plus reliability/test work.

targets.target: Verify the release date, material technical changes and maturity significance of vSomeIP-Lib 3.7.5; distinguish release existence from maintainer/project claims.
targets.finding: Release notes include multiple-major-version offerings, routing IPC/command refactoring, provider/consumer error separation, portability and extensive race/robustness/test improvements.

editorial.why_now_note: The release series spans October 2024 through August 2026 and provides an implementation-level view of a major open SOME/IP middleware stack evolving alongside SDV architecture changes.
editorial.rationale: Useful maturity/implementation trajectory for the runtime layer when kept distinct from standardization and deployment claims.
